purpose: WPF + WPF UI 外观效果图，非可运行软件

screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity straight-on 16:9 desktop application interface screenshot, ideally 1920x1080 or higher. It is a design concept for a Chinese Windows television live player built with WPF + WPF UI, using restrained Windows 11 Fluent styling. Not a photograph of a monitor, no perspective, no device frame, no presentation-board labels, no website browser chrome, no collage. Crisp beautifully typeset Simplified Chinese, Segoe UI / Microsoft YaHei-like typography, exact readable text, thin Fluent line icons. Consistent design system: near-black #101318 background, graphite #1C222B surfaces, subtle cool gray borders, off-white text, muted slate secondary text, soft ice-blue #87BEF8 accent. 8px spacing rhythm, 8-12px corner radius, restrained translucent charcoal acrylic only on overlays, generous whitespace, quiet professional design, no purple gradients, no neon, no ornamental dashboards. App name is simply “电视直播”. Make this feel like a real feasible WPF UI rather than a web dashboard.
The imaginary television video when present is an exceptionally beautiful cinematic documentary shot of layered green mountains and a broad winding river at golden dawn, soft mist, natural muted blue-green and gold, realistic imagery, no people, no subtitles, no giant branding. Programme title “山河之间”. Main selected channel is “浙江卫视”, number “06”.
SCREEN 1 / FULLSCREEN PLAYBACK: Entire canvas is the documentary video, edge to edge. Fullscreen viewing, absolutely no window titlebar or taskbar and no sidebar. Show the unobtrusive controls in their temporarily visible state, with a very gentle dark gradient at bottom to retain readability; most of the screen remains unobstructed imagery.
Top left small understated channel identifier “浙江卫视” and a tiny red live dot with “直播”. Top right elegant small clock “20:36”.
Bottom left at 60px margins: small secondary text “06 · 浙江卫视”, larger but restrained programme title “山河之间”, below in small type “20:00—21:00”.
Bottom center a compact lightweight translucent control bar, approximately 550px wide: previous channel icon, a prominent but subtle pause icon, next channel icon, divider, speaker icon and short volume slider, divider, “频道” list icon, star outline favorite icon. No seek bar, this is live TV.
Bottom right small “1080p” quality pill, gear settings icon, exit-fullscreen icon. Along very bottom faint key hints “↑ ↓ 换台    Enter 频道列表    Esc 退出全屏”. Maintain legible contrast but premium very sparse cinema-like screen.

Drawer footer separated by thin line: “↑ ↓ 选择    Enter 播放    Esc 返回”.
At bottom of uncovered video, small floating programme card “正在播放 · 浙江卫视” above “山河之间”. Richly polished yet feasible native Windows television interface.

2 “启动时全屏” / “直接进入沉浸观看” / toggle ON.

5 “控件自动隐藏” / “无操作时收起播放控制条” / dropdown “3 秒”.
6 “频道列表字号” / “适合远距离观看” / dropdown “大”.
A small understated bottom hint with keyboard icon “提示：按 F 切换全屏，按 Enter 打开频道列表”.
Use elegant restrained hierarchy and row spacing, beautiful readable simplified Chinese. All rows fit without scrolling. Toggle states are proposed design options only. Avoid engineering terminology such as HLS, URL, token, WebView2, codecs, DRM, source parsing, error logs. No excessive card decoration, no giant save button, no promotional content.
